text.title: Agency Pricing Tiers Failure Modes
text.summary: Six antipatterns observed when applying Agency Pricing Tiers. Each pairs symptom + root-cause + concrete fix. Detector clauses make them mechanically catchable.

antipattern.symptom: Best tier sells, revenue rises, profit falls; senior staff are fully booked on best-tier accounts.
antipattern.root-cause: Best tier packed with deliverables without costing the hours; margin never computed per tier.
antipattern.fix: Cost every tier per `r-best-tier-highest-margin`; strip or reprice best until its margin leads in both absolute and percentage terms.

antipattern.symptom: Tiers priced 5k / 10k / 15k; almost every buyer takes good; better rarely sells.
antipattern.root-cause: Linear gaps give the middle tier no anchor above it and no fence below it.
antipattern.fix: Reshape to 3/5/8 per `r-price-gaps-follow-3-5-8` and fence good per `r-good-tier-fenced-middle-tier-complete`.

antipattern.symptom: Better includes a deliverable that best does not; prospects ask "so if I upgrade I lose X?".
antipattern.root-cause: Tiers designed as three separate packages rather than as nested supersets.
antipattern.fix: Rebuild as strict supersets per `r-tiers-are-strict-supersets`; list quantities and turnaround per deliverable.

antipattern.symptom: Good-tier clients receive better-tier deliverables "as a favour"; good-tier margin trends toward zero over the engagement.
antipattern.root-cause: No written scope-up procedure; account managers say yes to keep the client happy.
antipattern.fix: Document trigger, price delta, approver and written confirmation per `r-scope-up-procedure-documented`.

antipattern.symptom: Three clients on the "better" tier pay three different prices; a referral asks for the lowest one.
antipattern.root-cause: Concessions made on price rather than on scope.
antipattern.fix: Hold published prices; trade deliverables per `r-discount-by-scope-not-price`.

antipattern.symptom: Proposal opens with the good tier; buyers negotiate downward from there and treat better as an upsell.
antipattern.fix: Reorder best, better, good with prices visible per `r-present-best-first`.
